1. Side elevation looking north. True scale 1:20 on ARCH D; heights from maker data, see SOURCE.
2. Gravity train RB-303 > DH-101 > SC-304 > DH-102 > MD-305 > FC-307: every joint opens by hand for dry cleaning.
3. DH-101 and DH-102 shown in section (hatched). Verify RB-303 valve flange and MD-305 aperture on certified GA.
4. Blender cover and grate interlocks wired to SR-607 (Cat 3 min); lock out before opening (OSHA 1910.147).
5. Bond all metal parts in the train to ground (< 10 ohm) against static ignition of spice dust.
6. Access platform for blender top supplied with RB-303 leg extension (OSHA 1910.29 guardrails).
